instruction: My mother has asked me what I'd like for dinner on phone. Reply her with any one of my favorite recipes' name from my Simple Note account. Just the name, nothing else.
notes: Two apps (phone, simple_note) plus supervisor. The mother's phone number is discovered via phone.search_contacts with relationship="mother"; phone.search_text_messages with that number locates her dinner question (reference solution uses it to confirm the thread). The favorite-recipes note is found via simple_note.search_notes and read via simple_note.show_note; one recipe name from it is sent verbatim with phone.send_text_message to the mother's number. The task asks no question, so supervisor.complete_task is called without an answer; its two PDDL parameters only identify the reply record (recipient, recipe) so that its precondition equals the goal condition. Static init facts link entities (relationship, phone number, note/query, recipe/note) that lookups make known at runtime; nothing is logged in and no password is known initially.
